requirements.statement: Admit exact Stage 2 squash/main CI and correct its receipt append-only.
Preserve all accepted schemas, financial semantics, histories, and claim boundaries.
Close only G003, G005, and G011; preserve every downstream owner.
Define immutable semantics for all four named profiles.
Make profile scale equal processor payment-event count and disclose all source counts.
Freeze seed, merchant/currency/settlement/posting, exception, split, skew, late, replay, conflict, missing, and policy-change parameters.
Derive dataset/run/batch/record IDs and timestamps solely from canonical semantic inputs, never wall-clock time or process order.
Generate in bounded memory with deterministic shard boundaries and ordering.
Emit all four families in the frozen heterogeneous raw format mapping and an equivalent strict canonical v2 JSONL/LF bundle without changing v2 schemas.
Emit digest-bound policy, run manifest, profile lock, scenario inventory, and canonical asset manifest.
Produce expected totals/reasons without importing or calling production reconciliation.
Recompute counts, bytes, digests, currency totals, and financial expectations with a separate streaming reader.
Cover every required normal, exception, replay/conflict, correction, skew, split, late, and policy scenario explicitly.
Execute deterministic property/metamorphic campaigns with reproducible case IDs and minimal failure records.
Read manifest-bound source objects into typed Spark DataFrames and derive candidates without accepting Python candidates as input.
Enforce identities, journal balance/roles, references, formulae, bank allocation, currency isolation, checked arithmetic, reason order, and non-authoritative output in Spark.
Prove logical parity against the accepted local engine and independent oracle on correctness fixtures.
Include accepted corrected-source behavior and packaged schemas in the runtime distribution.
Provide a Glue 5.1-compatible Python 3.11 / Spark 3.5.6 entrypoint and offline dependency closure.
Strictly require and bind run, attempt, policy/manifest, input/output/evidence, and control-record arguments.
Reject unsafe, ambiguous, mutable, overlapping, wrong-bucket, wrong-run, and cross-attempt S3 paths before Spark starts.
Write only immutable non-authoritative candidate output and completion evidence; no authoritative pointer.
Prove production package/import graph has no path to the reference oracle or generator expectations.
Emit an exact standards-based SBOM and artifact/member/toolchain inventory.
Make promised source/package artifacts byte-reproducible in two isolated clean builds.
Prove small/10K/100K generation and 1M generation capability within the 8 GB boundary.
Keep AWS SDK/client imports out of pure reconciliation modules and automatic CI without OIDC.
Give new owned branches 100% coverage and kill every non-equivalent semantic mutation.
Produce exact-head CI evidence and independently inspect its archive.
Close Stage 3 only after squash topology, tree equality, and independent green main CI are externally verified.
